organization.short_description:
MarineLabs is an ocean technology startup based in Victoria, British Columbia, founded in 2017 by CEO Scott Beatty. The company specializes in coastal intelligence, providing real-time, high-resolution weather data to enhance maritime safety and streamline operations. MarineLabs operates a unique hardware-and-software model, deploying compact, rugged sensor units across North America to collect hyper-local data on wind, waves, and weather conditions.

The flagship product, CoastAware™, is the world's first platform dedicated to real-time coastal intelligence. It offers subscription access to high-resolution data, AI-driven insights, and 360-degree buoy camera integration. MarineLabs' sensors are designed for rapid deployment and connectivity, creating a continuously expanding network that fills weather data gaps in coastal zones. The company serves a diverse range of clients, including port operators, vessel pilots, coastal engineers, and government agencies, providing critical data for safer and more efficient maritime operations.

organization.short_description:
Flash Forest is a Canadian reforestation startup founded in May 2019, recognized as the first and largest automated drone reforestation company globally. Based in Mississauga, Ontario, with operations in Toronto and Vancouver, the company aims to plant 1 billion trees by 2028 to combat climate change. Flash Forest utilizes advanced technologies such as drones, artificial intelligence, and geographic information systems to enhance ecological restoration efforts.

The company offers drone-based reforestation services that efficiently plant trees in challenging environments, including post-wildfire areas and remote terrains. Flash Forest's patented products include bio-engineered seed pods that promote healthy growth, a drone deployment system for precise seed placement, and machine learning software for optimizing planting strategies. With a commitment to safety, speed, and cost efficiency, Flash Forest partners with various public and private entities to execute large-scale reforestation projects across Canada and internationally.

organization.short_description:
Scanifly is a B2B software company that specializes in providing a comprehensive drone-based 3D design and field operations platform tailored for the solar industry. Founded in January 2015, the company centralizes all stages of solar project development, from initial site surveys to installation and maintenance. With over 150,000 projects processed and approximately $12.4 million in funding, Scanifly has established itself as a key player in the Multimedia and Design Software industry.

The platform integrates drone-based surveying techniques, such as LiDAR and photogrammetry, to create virtual 3D replicas of properties. This enables precise solar design without the need for physical site visits. Key offerings include Scanifly Prelim for initial photovoltaic system planning, Scanifly3D for managing field changes during installation, and Scanifly Mobile for on-site workflow management. The services provided encompass photorealistic 3D modeling, shading analysis, engineering support, and proposal generation, all aimed at enhancing efficiency and accuracy for solar contractors and firms across the solar value chain.

Uncountable Inc. is a technology company based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2016. The company specializes in AI-powered, cloud-native Unified Laboratory Informatics Platforms that help Research and Development (R&D) enterprises manage and analyze scientific data more effectively. Uncountable aims to accelerate innovation by integrating disparate data sets into a cohesive knowledge base, enabling advanced visualization, predictive analytics, and enhanced collaboration among scientists and researchers.

The company's primary offering is an enterprise-class platform that centralizes laboratory information management. It features unified data integration, AI-powered analytics, and real-time collaboration tools. Uncountable serves various industries, including Chemicals, Advanced Materials, Pharmaceuticals, and Food & Agriculture, targeting large-scale manufacturers and enterprise R&D laboratories. Notable clients include Plastic Ingenuity, Cooper Standard, and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, who utilize Uncountable's platform to modernize their R&D workflows and streamline data management.

organization.short_description:
Serve Robotics Inc. is a technology company based in Redwood City, California, specializing in autonomous, zero-emission sidewalk delivery robots. Founded in 2017, the company emerged from a research division of Postmates and became independent in 2021. It launched its commercial delivery service in 2022 and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol SERV.

The company offers a Delivery-as-a-Service platform that allows merchants to manage autonomous deliveries without owning the robots. Its services include on-demand sidewalk delivery, fleet management, and tele-assist capabilities. The Serve Robot, its primary product, is designed for urban environments and features advanced mobility, AI-driven navigation, and a secure cargo compartment. Serve Robotics partners with various brands, including Uber Eats and 7-Eleven, to provide efficient and sustainable last-mile delivery solutions across selected U.S. urban markets.
